page_title: LEV 1-4 STU | Bayer Leverkusen v Stuttgart 10/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's it for today, Felix Zwayer has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.

90' Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen) finds some space on the edge of the box after some nice individual play and curls a shot in on goal, but the ball flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Stuttgart will have a goal kick.
88' Sebastian Hoeness decides to make a substitution. Nikolas Nartey will be replaced by Chema Andres (VfB Stuttgart).
88' The attendance for today's match is 30210.
88' Substitution. Deniz Undav walks off the pitch and Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) comes on as a substitute.
86' Loic Bade (Bayer Leverkusen) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
85' Shots on target – 4:7.
82' Alejandro Grimaldo comes off the pitch to be replaced by Lucas Vazquez (Bayer Leverkusen).
80' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Felix Zwayer had an easy-decision to make.
79' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jeremy Arevalo (VfB Stuttgart) replacing Jamie Leweling.
79' A substitution has been made. Josha Vagnoman is replaced by Lorenz Assignon (VfB Stuttgart).
79' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) was quite harsh and Felix Zwayer didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
77' Finn Jeltsch (VfB Stuttgart) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
76' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 4:7.
73' Stuttgart can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
72' Substitution. Chris Fuhrich makes way for Finn Jeltsch (VfB Stuttgart).
70' Felix Zwayer shows a yellow card to Loic Bade (Bayer Leverkusen) for his blatant foul.
68' Stuttgart have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
66' Here is a change. Ezequiel Fernandez is going off and Kasper Hjulmand gives the last tactical orders to Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen).
66' Martin Terrier will be replaced by Alejo Sarco (Bayer Leverkusen).
66' 1 - 4 GOAL! Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes a real chance, but his low driven penalty into the middle of the net fools Alexander Nubel in goal.
66' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.

65' Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. The referee uncompromisingly points to the spot and it's a penalty to Bayer Leverkusen.

63' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the middle of the goal. Alexander Nubel guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
61' 12:10 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.

58' What a chance that is! Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Stuttgart will have a goal kick.
57' A quickly taken corner by Bayer Leverkusen.

57' Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. Bayer Leverkusen will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

54' What a big chance! Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Stuttgart.

52' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) tries his luck and hits a thunderbolt of a shot towards goal from long range, but his powerful strike goes narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Stuttgart will have a goal kick.
50' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
50' The linesman points to the corner flag, Stuttgart are going to take it.
47' The ball is cleared after Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Stuttgart.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
46' The game is over for Jeanuel Belocian (Bayer Leverkusen). Loic Bade comes on for the second half.
46' Half-time substitution. Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) is replaced by Ernest Poku.
45+4' Felix Zwayer has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' 0 - 4 Fantastic team goal! Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) was set free in the area by Chris Fuhrich and fired low past Mark Flekken. 0:4.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

45' 0 - 3 Goal! Great link up play between Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) and Deniz Undav gives the former a clear sight of goal on the edge of the box. He doesn't disappoint and beats the keeper in the bottom right corner. 0:3.
44' Bayer Leverkusen fail to score from a corner as Alexander Nubel (VfB Stuttgart) leaps to collect the ball.
43' Bayer Leverkusen are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
40' Bayer Leverkusen take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
40' Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. Bayer Leverkusen force a corner. They send men into the box.
38' Mark Flekken (Bayer Leverkusen) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
38' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
36' Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen) is obviously very disappointed with his shot from the rebound. He aims exactly at the goalkeeper's gloves. This should have been an easy goal!
36' The foul by Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) was seen by Felix Zwayer who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
34' A corner kick by Bayer Leverkusen is thwarted by the well prepared Alexander Nubel (VfB Stuttgart).

33' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) weaves his way through opponents and strikes the ball from the edge of the area, but it's blocked by a defender. Bayer Leverkusen have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
31' Ezequiel Fernandez (Bayer Leverkusen) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the middle of the goal was easily saved by Alexander Nubel.
31' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) receives a short pass and produces a low effort from mid-range towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper is alert and makes a routine save.
29' 0 - 2 Goal! Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Mark Flekken to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
29' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) is going to take the penalty!

28' Jeanuel Belocian (Bayer Leverkusen) makes a slide tackle, but referee Felix Zwayer blows for a foul. The referee makes a quick call and points to the penalty spot. Big scoring opportunity for Stuttgart.
26' Bayer Leverkusen take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
26' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. The referee blows his whistle, Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a corner kick.
24' Great teamplay by Bayer Leverkusen as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
21' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
19' Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Felix Zwayer has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
16' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
14' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen will have a goal kick.

13' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) is strong enough to get to the ball and produces a header from close range. Even though it was aimed precisely towards the middle of the goal, Mark Flekken didn't have a hard time stopping the attempt as it wasn't powerful enough.
12' Ezequiel Fernandez (Bayer Leverkusen) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
9' Stuttgart enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
7' 0 - 1 Goal - 0:1! Deniz Undav laid the ball off to Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart), who shot from close range low into the back of the net, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
5' The Bayer Leverkusen players are exchanging some short passes.
2' Mark Flekken makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the bottom right corner by Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) after a cross from the side.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Stuttgart will take the kick-off.
Felix Zwayer will officiate today.
